facts.text: AuntISARAApp builds the AuntISARA process-variable model in self.ioc and connects the command and status clients to the controller
The controller status and action are the STATUS and ACTION process variables
ActionType bits are MOUNT, DISMOUNT, PREFETCH and ABORTING
StatusType values are IDLE, WAITING, BUSY, STANDBY and FAULT (0 to 4)
The emergency input is INP:emerg and the collision sensor input is INP:colSensor
position_fbk is STATE:pos, tool_fbk is STATE:tool and the mounted sample is STATE:onDiff
dewar_temp1_fbk and dewar_temp2_fbk are STATE:dewarT1 and STATE:dewarT2
next_port is PAR:nextPort; tool_param, puck_param and sample_param are PAR:tool, PAR:puck and PAR:smpl
do_next_port validates a port and stores it in next_port, or empties it
A puck port is a PUCK_LIST prefix and a pin 1 to 16; PUCK_LIST holds 29 prefixes and NUM_PUCK_SAMPLES is 16
PORT_PATT accepts a puck prefix and a pin 1 to 16
send_command queues a command and formats arguments as command(arg,arg)
set_mount_params converts a port with port2args and writes tool_param, puck_param and sample_param
port2args converts a port such as 1A16 to puck, sample and tool for a UNIPUCK or DOUBLE tool
do_panic_cmd sends the native panic command
do_home_cmd sends the native home command with the current tool
abort_to_home sends abort, reset and safe and waits for HOME and IDLE
is_idle compares the controller status with StatusType.IDLE
